name: What are the signs of mold developing in wet ceiling drywall?

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of mold developing in wet ceiling drywall?

acceptedAnswer.text: Signs of mold developing in wet ceiling drywall include a musty or earthy odor, visible discoloration (often black, green, or white fuzzy patches), and worsening respiratory symptoms in occupants. Even if mold isn't visible, a persistent damp smell after drying may indicate hidden growth within walls or ceilings. Professional mold inspection may be needed to confirm and address it.
acceptedAnswer.description: Mold in wet ceiling drywall shows as musty odors, visible discoloration, or worsening respiratory issues, requiring inspection if suspected.
